data.title: Spectroscopy on a single trapped 137Ba+ ion for nuclear magnetic octupole moment determination
data.authors: Lewty, N. C.; Chuah, B. L.; Cazan, R.; Sahoo, B. K.; Barrett, M. D.
data.notes: Precision RF spectroscopy of a single trapped 137Ba+ ion in the 5d 2D3/2 manifold. Hyperfine A, B, C constants from Table 3. Values represent a 30-fold reduction in uncertainty compared to prior work. This paper reports the first observation of the magnetic octupole moment C in 137Ba+. Note: the 2013 PRA paper (doi:10.1103/PhysRevA.88.012518) by the same group reports slightly revised values with additional second-order corrections applied.

properties.notes: is_recommended=0 because the 2013 PRA paper (doi:10.1103/PhysRevA.88.012518) gives revised values with additional corrections. Use that paper's values preferentially.
